## Bugs and reliability

From 2026-11-05 a defect (behaviour that breaks something meant to work) gets a B- record here; earlier ones stayed in their F- records (owner decision).

## Other changes

**CI reliability evidence — B-046, 2026-11-08.** Original worker-cancellation failure retained, isolated diagnostic passed and only failed CI jobs were retried; root cause/fix remain open under B-046. Existing B-043 remains a separate queue-saturation finding.

**Target-schema correction and retirement recheck — Implemented, 2026-11-08.** [PR #221](https://github.com/voidbrain/nerv/pull/221) restores the active target with implemented/planned labels; recheck all 26 retired sources and preserve mixed design inputs outside remove/. Assess Gauntlet ownership/reuse versus existing benchmarks without creating a repository or running model campaigns. Local source/link/coverage metadata checks and fresh-context independent review passed. Next: required CI; archive this maintenance after its acceptance passes.
